critical_strata.name: regular_isolated_smooth
critical_strata.definition: Regular isolated roots with separated targets and stable branches.

critical_strata.name: narrow_close
critical_strata.definition: Narrow basins, close roots or close target values.

critical_strata.name: guard_boundary_domain
critical_strata.definition: Strict guards, artificial or geometric boundaries and domain singularities.

critical_strata.name: branch_and_target_collision
critical_strata.definition: Multiple branches, selector ties or many configurations sharing a target.

critical_strata.name: opaque_piecewise_transcendental
critical_strata.definition: Iterative, opaque, transcendental or piecewise-smooth plugin calls.

critical_strata.name: dimension_redundancy_gauge
critical_strata.definition: Higher dimension, redundant residuals and gauge freedom.

critical_strata.name: unbounded_extreme_scale
critical_strata.definition: Adaptive-unbounded domains or extreme variable/residual scale ranges.

unknown_levels.name: unseen_instance
unknown_levels.definition: New parameters from a known generator or template.

unknown_levels.name: unseen_composition
unknown_levels.definition: A new graph composition of known primitives.

unknown_levels.name: unseen_family
unknown_levels.definition: A held-out geometry/problem family with known ABI capabilities.

unknown_levels.name: unseen_plugin
unknown_levels.definition: A custom plugin family authored after ABI and policy freeze.

unknown_levels.name: out_of_envelope
unknown_levels.definition: Dimension, scale, branch count, evaluation cost or regularity outside the frozen tested envelope.

partitions.name: historical_prior_development
partitions.use: Hypothesis and regression development only; independently establish all truth.

partitions.name: synthetic_lab
partitions.use: Factorial generated families, micro-counterexamples and ablations.

partitions.name: locked_validation
partitions.use: One use after parameter freeze; opened failures burn the family set.

partitions.name: prospective_unknown
partitions.use: Created after policy freeze, including new plugin families.

partitions.name: generated_fuzz
partitions.use: Crash, semantic, concurrency and metamorphic robustness.

truth_levels.definition: Targets and configurations follow from the generator construction.
Sound interval validation establishes the required truth.
A restricted independent exact backend establishes truth.
Two independent formulations/solvers plus additional validation agree.
A long numerical union provides a miss diagnostic but not Gold truth.

grouping_rule: Keep common generator, construction template, constraint graph and closely related primitive family in the same partition.
